question: In which year did the members of the Indian Constituent Assembly first meet to draft a constitution for the country ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1946**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Constituent Assembly of India first met on **9 December 1946**.
 
• The Assembly was tasked with drafting the Constitution of India, which would lay the foundation for the country's governance and legal framework.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the permanent Chairman of the Constituent Assembly on **11 December 1946**.
 
• The Assembly included prominent leaders such as Jawaharlal Nehru, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, and Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constituent Assembly:**

 
 
• The Constituent Assembly was formed to draft the Constitution of India after independence from British rule.
 
• It consisted of 389 members, which included representatives from various provinces and princely states of India.
 
• The Assembly held numerous sessions over a period of nearly three years, from 1946 to 1949.
 
• The final draft of the Constitution was adopted on **26 November 1949**, and it came into effect on **26 January 1950**, celebrated as Republic Day in India.
 
 
 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar:**
 
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly.
 
• He played a crucial role in shaping the Indian Constitution and is often referred to as the principal architect of the Constitution.
 
• Ambedkar was a social reformer and a key advocate for the rights of Dalits and other marginalized communities in India.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Indian Constitution:**
 
 
• The Constitution of India establishes India as a sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic.
 
• It provides for a parliamentary system of government with a clear separation of powers between the executive, legislature, and judiciary.
 
• The Constitution includes a comprehensive set of fundamental rights and duties for Indian citizens.
 
• It also sets out the federal structure of government, with a division of powers between the central government and state governments.
